full_prompt_en: A square color fashion photograph crops a woman's face so closely that one green eye becomes the central point of attention. The left side and upper edge disappear into deep black shadow, with a sweep of dark hair crossing the brow. The visible eye looks directly outward. Its cool green iris catches a small bright reflection, while smoky black, blue, red, and yellow pigment gathers around the lids in a rough expressive haze. The bridge of the nose and a pale cheek extend down through the center, softly illuminated by a narrow beam from the upper left. The second eye is outside the dark crop and not visible. Softly closed natural-pink lips sit near the lower center, their edges less sharp than the eye. At the upper right, orange and golden petals press into the frame; a red-pink petal overlaps the outer eye area, and a bright turquoise-blue fragment appears along the right edge. Larger red blossoms fill the lower right, while a pale yellow-green leaf shape intrudes from the lower left. The flowers are close to the lens and partly soft, surrounding the face without forming a conventional backdrop. The image has deep fashion-photo blacks, saturated warm colors, and fine grain across the lit skin. Directional light grazes the nose, cheek, and eye, while the far-left face and background remain nearly unreadable in shadow. The shallow depth of field keeps the eye crisp and lets the petals blur at different distances. The overall composition is intimate and dramatic, pairing a still gaze with dense color, soft organic framing, and severe shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色时装照片把女子面庞裁得极近，使一只绿眼睛成为注意力中心。左侧和上缘消失在浓黑阴影里，一束深色头发横过眉部。可见的眼睛直视画外，冷绿虹膜接住细小亮反光，烟黑、蓝、红、黄色颜料则在眼睑周围聚成粗糙而富于表现力的雾状色层。鼻梁和浅色脸颊从中央向下延伸，被左上方的一道窄光柔和照亮。另一只眼睛落在深色裁切之外，并不可见。自然粉色的双唇轻轻闭合，位于下部中央，边缘不如眼睛锐利。右上方，橙色与金色花瓣挤入画面；一片红粉色花瓣遮到眼尾区域，一块明亮青蓝色碎形出现在右缘。较大的红花填满右下角，一片浅黄绿色叶形从左下探入。花朵靠近镜头且部分柔化，围住面部，却没有构成通常的背景。画面有深重的时尚摄影黑色、饱和暖色，以及受光肌肤上的细微颗粒。定向光擦亮鼻子、脸颊和眼睛，脸部最左侧与背景则近乎不可辨。浅景深让眼睛保持锐利，使不同距离的花瓣各有散焦。整体构图亲密而富戏剧性，把静止目光与密集色彩、柔软的有机围合和严厉阴影配在一起。
style_prompt_en: The color photograph uses a concentrated island of clarity inside broad near-black shadow. Cool green-blue accents and pale warm neutrals meet saturated orange, crimson, and occasional bright turquoise, with color clustered asymmetrically near the edges. Light is narrow and directional, grazing selected smooth planes while allowing much of the frame to disappear into darkness. The sharpest focal region carries fine grain and tiny specular points; nearby saturated shapes soften into shallow-focus blur. Edges range from an almost invisible dark transition to the crisp line of a lit central detail. Soft organic curves press inward around the focal opening, creating dense framing without a fully described environment. Warm and cool pigment-like color can gather in loose haze over otherwise photographic surfaces. The overall effect is luxurious, intimate, and moody, with strong selective focus and severe value contrast doing most of the visual work.
style_prompt_zh: 这类彩色照片在大片近黑阴影中保留一小块集中的清晰区域。冷绿蓝重音和浅暖中性色与饱和橙、深红及偶见明亮青蓝相遇，色彩不对称地聚在边缘附近。光线狭窄且有方向，擦过选定平顺平面，让大部分画幅消失在黑暗中。最锐利焦点区域有细微颗粒和小而集中的镜面亮点；邻近饱和形态则软化为浅景深模糊。边缘从几乎不可见的暗部过渡，到受光中央细节的清晰线条之间变化。柔软有机曲线朝焦点开口向内挤入，在不完整交代环境的情况下形成密集围框。颜料般的暖冷色彩可以在摄影表面上聚成松散薄雾。整体效果华丽、亲密且带阴郁气息，选择性对焦和严厉明度反差承担主要视觉作用。
theme_en: A close green-eyed face framed by shadow and warm flowers
theme_zh: 深影与暖色花朵围住的一张绿眼面庞特写
name: Mario Sorrenti
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
